document: ET-8b gen1_crossfit heads — per-decision, the architecture FIXED at gen0
⚠️_why_CV_here: the cross-fitted source runs cover tasks 1-225 only, so a head fitted on task_id < 226 has an empty held-out mask. The parent fitter writes 0.0%% with every control at 0.0 in that case, which reads as a failed head with PASSING controls when nothing was measured at all. Accuracy and all three controls are computed inside the CV loop here.
architecture_not_rechosen: gen0 applied docs/et8b-loop-gates.md §3 before any loop ran and selected per-decision; this generation inherits it. Nothing here is selected on the evaluation.
